definitions.gloss: to trim evenly; to cut to a uniform length
definitions.explanation: To cut multiple things so they are all the same length or shape. Used for hair, hedges, nails, paper, and similar items.

examples.japanese: ⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{切|き}り{揃|そろ}えた。
examples.english: I had my hair trimmed evenly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{生垣|いけがき}→生垣：18309_ikegaki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{切|き}り{揃|そろ}えた。
⟦{爪|つめ}→爪：02159_tsume⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{切|き}り{揃|そろ}えて⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{面接|めんせつ}→面接：01100_mensetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}かった→向かう：01186_mukau⟧。
examples.english: I trimmed my nails neatly before heading to the interview.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound verb combining ⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧ (to cut) and ⟦{揃|そろ}える→揃える：01952_soroeru⟧ (to arrange uniformly). Emphasizes making things even and uniform, not just cutting.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{切|き}り{揃|そろ}える (to trim hair evenly)
- ⟦{前髪|まえがみ}→前髪：19004_maegami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{切|き}り{揃|そろ}える (to trim bangs evenly)
- ⟦{生垣|いけがき}→生垣：18309_ikegaki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{切|き}り{揃|そろ}える (to trim a hedge)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧: to cut — general cutting without the nuance of uniformity
- ⟦{整|ととの}える→整える：04259_totonoeru⟧: to arrange, to put in order — broader, not specific to cutting
